LoloBuy product link not working? Check it before manual order

Verify the source URL and rebuild the product record without guessing the specification, price or warehouse freight.

⌕

Ordering workflow · 11 minute read

When a LoloBuy product link is not working, rebuild the order from facts

A LoloBuy product link not working does not automatically mean the item is sold out, the seller has rejected the order or the platform cannot buy it. The failure may occur before any order exists: the pasted address may be incomplete, the source page may require a session, the seller may have changed the listing, or the automatic product reader may not return usable details.

LoloBuy’s current public web application accepts a product link or product name in search. When a URL cannot be loaded into the normal product-detail flow, the application can route that URL to a Manual Order page. The manual form requires a valid web address plus the product name, specifications, commodity price, freight to warehouse and purchase quantity. It also offers Add to shopping cart and Buy now actions.

Manual entry is a fallback, not permission to guess. This checklist explains how to preserve the seller’s actual offer, create an auditable item record and review it before payment.

1. Test the source link before changing the order method

Copy the full product-page URL from the seller’s page, not a search-results address, an image, a chat message without a clickable address or a shortened redirect whose destination you have not checked. LoloBuy’s manual form validates that the link begins with http:// or https://, but a technically valid URL can still lead to the wrong page.

Open the address in a separate browser tab. Confirm that it resolves to one identifiable item and that the page still shows the seller, product title, available variants and purchasing information. Remove accidental spaces or punctuation copied after the URL. If the page opens only after a login or inside another application, record that limitation instead of assuming LoloBuy will see the same view.

Save the original URL before trying an alternative. If a seller provides both a share link and a direct item link, keep a note of which one displays the complete listing. Do not replace the seller’s page with a review, spreadsheet row or unrelated catalog page.

2. Separate a parsing failure from a listing problem

Automatic parsing normally attempts to produce a product-detail page with images, title, attributes, price and selectable combinations. A failure at this step only shows that the automated flow did not produce the expected record. It does not prove stock, seller acceptance, purchasing eligibility or the final transaction price.

Check the source listing itself for visible signs that the item changed: a new URL, removed variant, altered title, purchase limit or page-unavailable notice. If the seller’s page no longer provides enough information to identify what you want, manual order cannot repair the missing evidence.

If the listing is clear but LoloBuy still opens Manual Order, continue only after capturing every field needed to reproduce your intended selection. The aim is to replace missing automation with explicit data, not with assumptions.

3. Capture a source snapshot

Before typing into the manual form, create a small source record. Save the item link, seller or shop name, exact product title, selected colour, size or model, unit price shown for that selection, domestic freight shown by the seller, desired quantity and one representative image. Add the date you checked the page.

Variant-dependent pages deserve extra care. A listing may display one headline price while a specific size, bundle or colour has a different amount. Select the intended combination on the seller page before recording the price. If a required variant is unavailable, do not enter another specification merely to make the form complete.

Keep evidence readable but privacy-safe. Product screenshots do not need your account name, address, payment details or private messages. The useful evidence is the seller’s item data and your exact selection.

4. Complete every required Manual Order field

The current LoloBuy manual form identifies six required inputs: Product link, Product Name, Product specifications, Commodity price, Freight to warehouse and Purchase quantity. The page also permits one product image and calculates a displayed total from the entered unit price, quantity and warehouse freight.

Use the canonical source URL in Product link. Copy a recognizable seller title into Product Name. In Product specifications, write the complete combination needed to distinguish the item, such as colour, size, model, version, material option or bundle. Keep each label and value together so that “black / 42 / standard version” cannot be mistaken for three unrelated notes.

Enter the selected item’s unit price, not a cart total, deposit, promotional banner or price range. Enter seller-to-warehouse freight separately. Then set the quantity and check whether the displayed manual total equals unit price multiplied by quantity plus domestic freight.

5. Do not use specifications as a substitute for evidence

A detailed specification helps a purchasing agent understand the request, but it does not change the seller’s listing. If the page offers “navy” and you type “royal blue,” the manual record does not create a new seller option. Likewise, a remark cannot make an unavailable size available or turn one model into another.

Use the seller’s own variant names whenever possible. For items with confusing identifiers, include both the visible label and the seller’s code. If two options look similar, use a product image only as supporting context; the written specification should still identify the correct choice.

If the source is ambiguous, pause before cart or payment. A question asked while the order is still editable is easier to resolve than a disagreement after the seller has dispatched an item.

6. Reconcile price and currency without guessing

The current manual page labels commodity price and freight to warehouse in CNY. Copy the live seller values relevant to the selected variant and do not convert them using a remembered exchange rate. The product-detail guidance also states that displayed pricing can be reference information and that the final transaction price is based on the order-settlement page.

If the seller shows a coupon, membership reduction, deposit, minimum order or price range, do not assume it will apply. Record the ordinary selected-variant amount and describe the condition separately if needed. A promotional screenshot is not proof that a third-party buyer can use the same benefit.

The manual total is a useful arithmetic check, not a promise that the seller will accept the transaction unchanged. Preserve the source snapshot so any later adjustment can be compared with the information available when you submitted the request.

7. Keep domestic and international freight separate

“Freight to warehouse” is the seller’s domestic delivery charge for sending the purchased item to the designated warehouse. It is not international shipping to your home. LoloBuy’s confirmation interface explicitly treats international freight as a separate later calculation.

This distinction matters when a broken product link sends you to manual order. The total on that form combines goods, quantity and domestic freight; it does not describe the cost of the later international parcel. International shipping depends on the stored goods, final parcel, destination and available line at the parcel-submission stage.

Do not enter an estimated international amount into the warehouse-freight field. Doing so would distort the product-order record and make later reconciliation harder.

8. Choose Add to cart or Buy now deliberately

Add to shopping cart is useful when you want another review step or plan to order more items. LoloBuy’s cart groups goods by shop, tracks selected quantity, includes product amounts and warehouse freight, and routes selected items to Confirm Order. Buy now moves the manually created item toward confirmation more directly.

Neither button should replace validation. Before continuing, agree to the displayed disclaimer only after reading it. The manual-order notice says third-party special-platform items can involve additional service conditions, may not be orderable, may carry delivery risk, may have different return or exchange support and may receive only appearance inspection. The specific result depends on staff verification.

If you need time to compare the source page with your entry, use the cart as a checkpoint. Reopen the item and verify the link, specification, unit price, domestic freight and quantity.

9. Audit the Confirm Order page

At confirmation, compare the manually entered record line by line with the source snapshot. Check the shop identity, item image, product title, complete specification, unit price, quantity, domestic freight and any added service. Confirm that the displayed total contains only the elements shown on the page.

Do not approve a mismatch because the product image looks correct. Sellers can use the same image across several variants, and a manual order may use the one image you uploaded. The text fields carry the details that purchasing staff need.

Keep the international-freight notice in view: paying for the product order does not submit an international parcel. Goods that are successfully purchased are sent to the warehouse first, where the later storage, inspection and parcel workflow begins.

10. Preserve an audit trail after submission

Save the order number, submitted item record, source URL and source snapshot. If LoloBuy asks for clarification or a price difference, compare the request with the exact variant and seller information you recorded. Use the order number when contacting support so the question is attached to the correct business record.

A submitted manual order is not proof that the seller has accepted it, that the item remains available or that every after-sales option applies. Watch the order record and customer-message area for actual updates. Describe what the interface shows rather than predicting a purchasing or warehouse result.

If the source listing changes after submission, keep both versions. A dated comparison can show whether the difference came from your entry, the seller’s later edit or a requested substitution.

Final LoloBuy product-link checklist

When a LoloBuy product link is not working, first verify the complete http:// or https:// URL and confirm that the seller page still identifies one purchasable item. Distinguish an automated parsing failure from a removed or ambiguous listing, then capture the exact title, variant, price, warehouse freight, quantity and image.

Enter every required manual field from that evidence, keep domestic and international freight separate, audit the cart or Confirm Order page and preserve the source snapshot with the order number. Manual order is safest when it reconstructs a clear seller offer—not when it fills missing information with a guess.
